name: Live DeepSeek V4 Pro rises on a private agent bench
title: Live DeepSeek V4 Pro rises on a private agent bench
summary: LobeHub measured the current DeepSeek V4 Pro web endpoint at 32 of 50 on its private LobeBench Hard 50 agent set (64%), versus 24 of 50 (48%) for the 0813 version. The gap is mainly tasks completed successfully three times in a row. Commenters disagree on whether the endpoint is a new V4.1 checkpoint, and one says DeepSeek's enterprise account called that label false.
